name: Shojo ∞ Rape
source:
It's an ordinary day as usual. Main character rapes a girl. He drags her to the bushes in the park and deprives of virginity. And having done it once without getting caught, he is sure he can repeat it again the next day.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-november-2006-haruka-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
